survivors.R1: Equivalent through the render command: render.ts reads the sequence and swimlane members only for a v7 draft, and the mutant drops that version gate. Render takes only a draft whose check passed, and a v6 or earlier draft carrying a sequence or swimlane kind or member always has field-version findings (killed C5, C9 and the check tests), so no draft that reaches the conversion distinguishes the two. The gate is kept as the requirement's statement that a v6 draft renders exactly as version 2.4 renders it.
